evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall be available as a mobile application for both Android and iOS devices.

issues.detected_issue: for both Android and iOS devices
issues.explanation: This combines two platform obligations in one statement. If one platform is delivered and the other is not, verification yields a partial result, which weakens singularity.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall be available as a mobile application for Android devices. The system shall be available as a mobile application for iOS devices.

issues.detected_issue: be available as a mobile application
issues.explanation: This is more of a product/platform constraint than a functional behavior. It is better categorized as a non-functional/platform requirement.
issues.suggested_fix: The mobile application shall operate on Android devices running supported OS versions. The mobile application shall operate on iOS devices running supported OS versions.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall fully load and be ready for user interaction within a maximum of two seconds after startup.

issues.detected_issue: fully load and be ready for user interaction
issues.explanation: The statement contains two related but distinct outcomes: loading and readiness for interaction. These should be separated or one should be defined as the measurable acceptance condition.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall be ready for user interaction within 2 seconds after startup.

issues.explanation: "Fully load" is ambiguous unless the exact loaded state is defined. Different stakeholders may interpret it differently.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall display the home screen and enable user input within 2 seconds after startup.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall display current football news relevant to the user's selected favorite teams.

issues.explanation: "Current" is vague because it does not define recency or update interval.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall display football news items published within the last 24 hours for the user's selected favorite teams.

issues.explanation: "Relevant" is subjective and allows multiple interpretations unless relevance rules are defined.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall display football news items tagged with at least one of the user's selected favorite teams.

issues.detected_issue: relevant to the user's selected favorite teams
issues.explanation: Without an objective mapping rule, a tester cannot determine pass/fail consistently.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall display football news items whose metadata contains the identifier of at least one user-selected favorite team.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall allow users to individually select preferred sports news channels for display.
The system shall provide a live ticker module that displays real-time results for the user's favorite teams.

issues.explanation: "Real-time" is ambiguous unless a maximum latency is specified.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall provide a live ticker module that displays match result updates for the user's favorite teams within 5 seconds of receipt from the external data source.

issues.explanation: A tester cannot objectively verify "real-time" without a measurable timing threshold.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall display live ticker result updates for the user's favorite teams within 5 seconds after the external API publishes the update.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall provide coverage of all national and international football leagues and competitions.

issues.detected_issue: all national and international football leagues and competitions
issues.explanation: The scope is undefined and potentially unbounded. "All" is ambiguous without an authoritative source or list.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall provide coverage for the football leagues and competitions listed in the approved product catalog.

issues.explanation: "Coverage" is not defined as a specific system behavior, such as displaying fixtures, results, standings, or news.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall display fixtures, results, and standings for each football league and competition listed in the approved product catalog.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall display detailed team and player information on demand.

issues.explanation: "Detailed" is subjective because it does not define which data elements must be shown.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall display team name, league, standings, roster, and recent results, and player name, position, club, and statistics when requested by the user.

issues.explanation: The trigger is informal and should be expressed as a clear condition or user action.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall display team and player information when the user selects a team or player from the user interface.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall integrate live stream links from external providers (e.g., DAZN, Sky Sport) and display them when a live broadcast has begun.

issues.detected_issue: integrate live stream links from external providers and display them
issues.explanation: This combines integration of external links with conditional display behavior. These are separate requirements.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall retrieve live stream links from approved external providers. The system shall display a live stream link when the associated live broadcast has begun.

issues.explanation: Examples are not a complete verification basis. The approved provider set should be explicitly defined.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall retrieve live stream links from the providers listed in the approved provider configuration.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall ensure that live stream links are only displayed when transmission rights are fulfilled for the user's country.

issues.explanation: The phrase is legally and operationally vague. The system needs an objective rights-status condition to evaluate.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall display a live stream link only when the rights database indicates that the linked broadcast is licensed for the user's country.

issues.explanation: "Ensure" states an assurance goal rather than a directly testable behavior unless the decision rule is defined.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall suppress display of a live stream link when the rights database indicates that the broadcast is not licensed for the user's country.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall retrieve live ticker data via an API from an external server.
The system shall update live ticker data in the user interface within a few seconds of real-world events.

issues.explanation: This is a vague quantifier and cannot be interpreted consistently.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall update live ticker data in the user interface within 5 seconds of receipt of an event update from the external API.

issues.explanation: The system may not observe real-world events directly; this creates an unverifiable reference point. Verification should use a measurable source event such as API publication or receipt.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall update live ticker data in the user interface within 5 seconds after the external API publishes the event update.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall provide a user interface that allows direct access to all app modules and information.

issues.explanation: "Direct access" is ambiguous because it does not define how many steps or interactions are allowed.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall allow the user to access each app module from the home screen in no more than 2 user actions.

issues.explanation: The scope of "all" and "information" is undefined and difficult to verify unless enumerated.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall provide navigation from the home screen to each module listed in the navigation specification.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall allow users to customize the user interface theme (e.g., light/dark mode or color schemes).

issues.explanation: Examples do not establish the minimum required capability. The supported theme options should be explicitly defined.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall allow users to select and apply one of at least two user interface themes: light mode and dark mode.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall provide a notification system that informs users about current events when notifications are enabled.

issues.explanation: "Current events" is too broad and undefined. The event types must be enumerated.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall send notifications for match start, score change, match end, and published news items when notifications are enabled for the relevant team.

issues.explanation: This describes an outcome in general terms rather than a measurable delivery behavior.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall deliver a push notification to the user's device within 5 seconds of a configured event when notifications are enabled.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall require all users to register and log in before accessing any app features.

issues.explanation: Registration and login are two separate system behaviors and should be specified independently.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall require a user to register before accessing protected app features. The system shall require an authenticated login before accessing protected app features.

issues.explanation: This may conflict with public or informational features unless the protected feature scope is defined.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall require user authentication before access to personalization, notifications, and content-sharing features.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall allow users to personalize their experience by following favorite clubs.

issues.explanation: This phrase is subjective and does not specify the exact system behavior.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall allow users to select and store one or more favorite clubs in their user profile.

issues.explanation: The phrase hints at behavior but does not define the resulting system action or stored state.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall store the user's selected favorite clubs and use them to filter displayed news, results, and notifications.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall allow users to receive notifications about news or results related to their favorite teams.

issues.explanation: This combines two notification categories in one statement. They may require separate triggers and test cases.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall allow users to receive notifications about news related to their favorite teams. The system shall allow users to receive notifications about match results related to their favorite teams.

issues.explanation: The relation rule is not defined. A consistent tagging or metadata criterion is needed.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall allow users to receive notifications for news items and match results tagged with at least one of the user's favorite teams.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall allow users to share news articles and game reports via social media directly from the app.

issues.explanation: This combines two content types in one requirement. If treated differently in implementation, they should be separated.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall allow users to share news articles via social media from the app. The system shall allow users to share game reports via social media from the app.

issues.explanation: The target sharing mechanisms or supported platforms are not defined.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall allow users to share a news article or game report using the mobile operating system's native share interface.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall function reliably with limited network coverage, allowing access to previously loaded content and basic navigation when offline.

issues.explanation: "Reliably" is subjective and not measurable without availability or success criteria.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall provide offline access to previously loaded content and basic navigation when network connectivity is unavailable.

issues.explanation: This condition is vague and difficult to reproduce consistently in testing.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall provide offline access to previously loaded content and basic navigation when the device has no network connectivity.

issues.detected_issue: allowing access to previously loaded content and basic navigation
issues.explanation: This contains multiple behaviors: offline content access and offline navigation.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall display previously loaded content when the device has no network connectivity. The system shall allow navigation between locally available screens when the device has no network connectivity.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall require an active internet connection for live data and live stream features.

issues.detected_issue: live data and live stream features
issues.explanation: This combines two distinct feature categories with the same constraint. Separate requirements improve traceability and verification.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall require an active internet connection to access live data features. The system shall require an active internet connection to access live stream features.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall support up to 100,000 concurrent users without performance degradation.

issues.explanation: This phrase is vague because no measurable performance threshold is given.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall support 100,000 concurrent users while maintaining a 95th-percentile server response time of 2 seconds or less for all read requests.

issues.explanation: A tester cannot determine pass/fail unless specific throughput, latency, or error-rate criteria are defined.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall support 100,000 concurrent users with an error rate below 1% and a 95th-percentile response time not exceeding 2 seconds.

issues.explanation: This is a scalability/performance constraint and should be categorized as a non-functional requirement rather than a functional one.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall maintain the specified performance thresholds while serving 100,000 concurrent users.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall undergo thorough testing and support processes before release to detect and resolve malfunctions.

issues.explanation: "Thorough" is subjective, and "support processes" is broad and undefined.
issues.suggested_fix: Before release, the project shall execute the test cases defined in the approved verification plan and resolve all critical defects.

issues.detected_issue: undergo thorough testing and support processes before release
issues.explanation: This is a project/process requirement, not a system requirement describing system behavior or quality attributes.
issues.suggested_fix: Before release, the project shall execute system, integration, and regression tests defined in the approved verification plan.

issues.explanation: Detection and resolution are separate obligations and belong to process requirements.
issues.suggested_fix: Before release, the project shall identify defects through execution of the approved test suite. Before release, the project shall correct all critical defects identified by the approved test suite.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall continuously evaluate user feedback and app reviews to improve functionality.

issues.detected_issue: continuously evaluate user feedback and app reviews
issues.explanation: This is an organizational/product management activity, not a system behavior requirement.
issues.suggested_fix: The product team shall review user feedback and app reviews at least once per release cycle.

issues.explanation: "Continuously" is vague unless an exact frequency or triggering condition is defined.
issues.suggested_fix: The product team shall review user feedback and app reviews weekly.

issues.explanation: This expresses an intent or business goal rather than a measurable, verifiable outcome.
issues.suggested_fix: The product team shall record, classify, and prioritize user feedback items in the issue-tracking system within 5 business days of receipt.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall process all personal user data in compliance with the GDPR.

issues.explanation: This references a broad regulation without specifying the concrete system behaviors required for verification.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall record explicit user consent before processing personal data for optional features, and shall delete a user's personal data within 30 days of an approved erasure request.

issues.detected_issue: process all personal user data in compliance with the GDPR
issues.explanation: Full regulatory compliance cannot be verified from this single abstract statement without decomposing it into specific obligations.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall provide functions to obtain consent, export personal data, and delete personal data in accordance with approved privacy requirements.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall be fully loaded and ready for user interaction within two seconds of app launch on supported Android and iOS devices under typical network conditions.

issues.detected_issue: fully loaded and ready for user interaction
issues.explanation: This combines two outcomes that should be reduced to one measurable state.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall be ready for user interaction within 2 seconds of app launch on supported Android devices under the defined test conditions. The system shall be ready for user interaction within 2 seconds of app launch on supported iOS devices under the defined test conditions.

issues.explanation: The phrase does not identify the exact observable loaded state.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall display the home screen and accept user input within 2 seconds of app launch.

issues.explanation: This is a vague environmental condition and is not reproducible unless quantified.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall display the home screen and accept user input within 2 seconds of app launch when tested on supported devices with network latency not exceeding 100 ms and bandwidth of at least 10 Mbps.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall support at least 100,000 concurrent users without performance degradation, including during peak match days.

issues.explanation: This phrase is vague and requires measurable limits.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall support 100,000 concurrent users with a 95th-percentile response time of 2 seconds or less and an error rate below 1%.

issues.explanation: "Peak match days" is informal unless the traffic profile is defined.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall support 100,000 concurrent users under the peak traffic profile defined in the load-test specification.

issues.explanation: A tester cannot verify this condition consistently without a documented workload model.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall satisfy the specified concurrency and response-time thresholds under the peak workload defined in the load-test specification.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall update and display live ticker data within five seconds of real-world events as provided by the external API.

issues.explanation: Updating internal data and displaying it are two separate behaviors, even if closely related.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall update live ticker data within 5 seconds after the external API publishes an event update. The system shall display updated live ticker data within 5 seconds after the external API publishes an event update.

issues.detected_issue: real-world events as provided by the external API
issues.explanation: This mixes two time references: the real-world event and the API-provided event. Verification should use the observable API event timestamp or receipt time.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall display updated live ticker data within 5 seconds after receipt of an event update from the external API.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall provide offline access to previously loaded news, team, and player information, and allow basic navigation when network connectivity is unavailable.

issues.detected_issue: provide offline access to previously loaded news, team, and player information, and allow basic navigation
issues.explanation: This combines content availability and navigation behavior in one requirement.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall provide offline access to previously loaded news, team, and player information when network connectivity is unavailable. The system shall allow navigation between locally available screens when network connectivity is unavailable.

issues.explanation: "Basic" is subjective and should be replaced by explicitly named navigation capabilities.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall allow the user to open the home screen, favorites screen, and previously loaded content screens when network connectivity is unavailable.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall ensure that live stream links are only displayed to users in countries where the respective transmission rights are fulfilled.

issues.explanation: The rights criterion is not operationally defined. The system needs a clear source of truth and decision rule.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall display a live stream link only when the rights service indicates that the linked broadcast is licensed in the user's country.

issues.explanation: "Ensure" expresses intent rather than a directly testable behavior unless translated into explicit display/suppression rules.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall suppress a live stream link when the rights service indicates that the linked broadcast is not licensed in the user's country.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall process all personal user data in full compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), including user consent, data minimization, and right to erasure.

issues.detected_issue: including user consent, data minimization, and right to erasure
issues.explanation: This bundles several distinct compliance obligations into one requirement. Each must be specified independently for verification.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall record explicit user consent before processing optional personal data. The system shall store only the personal data fields defined in the approved data model for each feature. The system shall delete a user's personal data within 30 days of an approved erasure request.

issues.detected_issue: full compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR)
issues.explanation: This is too broad to have one clear interpretation as a single requirement and should be decomposed into concrete system behaviors.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall provide consent capture, personal data export, and personal data deletion functions as specified in the approved privacy requirements.

issues.explanation: This principle is not directly testable without defined data fields and collection constraints.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall collect only the personal data attributes listed in the approved data dictionary for each feature.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall require all users to register and log in before accessing any app features.

issues.detected_issue: allow users to register and log in before accessing any app features
issues.explanation: This is primarily a functional access-control behavior, not a non-functional requirement.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall require user authentication before access to protected app features.

issues.explanation: Registration and login are separate functional behaviors and should be split.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall require a user to register before using protected app features. The system shall require a user to log in before using protected app features.

issues.explanation: This is overly broad unless all features truly require authentication; the protected scope should be explicit.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall require user authentication before access to personalization, notification, and content-sharing features.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall allow users to select and apply at least two UI themes (e.g., light and dark mode) for personalization.
The system shall maintain consistent user interface layout and module availability regardless of external server updates.

issues.explanation: This combines UI consistency and feature availability into one requirement.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall maintain the specified user interface layout after external server content updates. The system shall maintain access to all locally implemented modules after external server content updates.

issues.explanation: "Consistent" is subjective unless defined against a baseline or specification.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall preserve the navigation structure, screen order, and control positions defined in the approved UI specification after external server content updates.

issues.explanation: This is broad and needs a defined event or update type to test against.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall preserve the approved UI layout after receipt of external content-data updates from the server.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall undergo comprehensive testing and support processes prior to release to detect and resolve malfunctions, with user feedback and app reviews continuously evaluated post-release for improvements.

issues.detected_issue: undergo comprehensive testing and support processes prior to release
issues.explanation: This is a lifecycle/process requirement, not a system requirement.
issues.suggested_fix: Before release, the project shall execute the approved verification plan and correct all critical defects.

issues.detected_issue: detect and resolve malfunctions, with user feedback and app reviews continuously evaluated post-release for improvements
issues.explanation: This combines multiple unrelated process obligations across pre-release and post-release activities.
issues.suggested_fix: Before release, the project shall execute the approved test suite to identify defects. Before release, the project shall correct all critical defects. After release, the product team shall review user feedback and app reviews weekly.

issues.explanation: "Comprehensive" is subjective and unverifiable without scope definition.
issues.suggested_fix: Before release, the project shall execute all test cases defined in the approved verification plan.

issues.explanation: "Continuously" is vague and should be replaced by a defined frequency.
issues.suggested_fix: After release, the product team shall review user feedback and app reviews once per week.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall ensure that registration and login processes can be completed within ten seconds under typical network conditions.

issues.explanation: Registration and login are different processes and should be measured separately.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall complete user registration within 10 seconds under the defined test conditions. The system shall complete user login within 10 seconds under the defined test conditions.

issues.explanation: "Ensure" is weaker than specifying the direct measurable behavior.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall complete user login within 10 seconds under the defined test conditions.

issues.explanation: This test condition is vague and not reproducible unless quantified.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall complete user login within 10 seconds when tested with network latency not exceeding 100 ms and bandwidth of at least 10 Mbps.

evaluations.gen_requirement: The system shall provide notifications to users within five seconds of relevant events when the notification function is activated.

issues.explanation: The triggering events are not defined, so different stakeholders may interpret them differently.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall provide notifications within 5 seconds of a match start, score change, match end, or publication of a news item configured by the user.

issues.explanation: This phrase should specify whether activation is a user setting, per-team subscription, or global permission state.
issues.suggested_fix: The system shall provide notifications within 5 seconds of a configured event when the user has enabled notifications for the relevant team and granted device notification permission.
